tools.name: search
tools.description: Search by name across organisations (companies, associations, public bodies), communes, elected officials, public officials heading an administration and site topics. Each result has a site path whose last segment is the id for the detail tools (/organisation/<SIREN>, /commune/<INSEE>, /elus/<id>, /

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Home page headline figures: national key facts with their period, public contracts per year and median commune spending per inhabitant by population band. The State budget and the largest recipients are in get_state_budget and list_organisations.

tools.name: list_organisations
tools.description: Largest public contract winners (companies), largest recipients of State payments (associations) and largest public buyers, with national totals.

tools.name: get_organisation
tools.description: One organisation by SIREN: identity, public contracts won and awarded since 2019 (yearly totals, main counterparts, largest and latest contracts), State payments, documented corporate group, lobbying declarations (HATVP and EU register), competition on its tenders and its upcoming tenders.

tools.name: list_communes
tools.description: Communes overview: number of communes, largest communes with spending per inhabitant, median spending per inhabitant by population band, spending per inhabitant of each département's communes, and the national DGF grant history in commune accounts.

tools.name: get_commune
tools.description: One commune by INSEE code (Paris, Lyon and Marseille arrondissements map to their commune). By default, its accounts per inhabitant for one year against the median of communes of the same size. Sections: history (yearly accounts since 2018), functions (spending by service), local (local tax rates, i

tools.name: get_departement
tools.description: One département by code (01 to 95, 2A, 2B, 971 to 976): spending per inhabitant of its communes against the median of communes of the same size (most populous first, 50 per page), accounts of the département council and its region over time, and electoral turnout.

tools.name: list_local_authorities
tools.description: Accounts of regions (level region) or intercommunalités (level epci) for one year: spending, revenue and debt, also per inhabitant, 50 per page, filterable by name or SIREN, with the 8 highest spenders per inhabitant among matches.

tools.name: get_state_budget
tools.description: The State's general budget (budget général). By default: total executed spending, by mission and programme, revenue by tax and budget voted for next year. Use it for the State budget; get_public_money family etat is a different perimeter (Insee national accounts of all State administrations). Sectio

tools.name: get_public_money
tools.description: All French public money in Insee national accounts (State, State operators, local authorities, social security) by sector and by function, compulsory levies, European comparisons and quarterly debt. Pass `family` for one family's detailed accounts. Family etat covers all State administrations in nat

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Thematic analyses. Without `slug`, lists them. With a slug, returns that analysis's data series and sources: public deficit and debt by presidency, France and the EU budget, Paris spending, rail funding, student support.

tools.name: get_procurement
tools.description: Public procurement overview. By default: latest contracts, largest buyers and winners, contracts by buyer département. Sections: breakdown (contracts by month, procedure and type), quality (publication quality), sanctions (Competition Authority sanctions), opportunities (upcoming tenders), competiti

tools.name: get_lobbying
tools.description: Lobbying registers (HATVP for France, EU Transparency Register). By default: totals, organisations with the most declared activities, targeted institutions and ministries, declared budgets and links with public contracts and State payments. Sections: defaults (HATVP declaration defaults, 50 per page

tools.name: get_political_finance
tools.description: Political party accounts (CNCCFP): 2024 resources, donations and public aid of every party (50 per page, largest first), total public aid per year since 2021, the selected party's history and parties deprived of public aid. `party` is a CNCCFP party code from the accounts list; it selects the party

tools.name: list_campaign_accounts
tools.description: Candidates' campaign accounts for the 2024 legislative or European elections (CNCCFP), 50 per page, with totals and counts by decision code. Filter by candidate or constituency name, département code or decision code. With `query`, also the matching entries of the index of 2026 municipal decisions (

tools.name: get_campaign_account
tools.description: One candidate's campaign account (CNCCFP) with every line. `id` is the candidate_id from list_campaign_accounts. Amounts are in cents.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Campaign account alerts from CNCCFP decisions: rejected accounts, accounts not filed and accounts filed late, newest first, 50 per page. They are official decisions, not proof of an offence.

tools.name: list_elected
tools.description: Current deputies, senators and members of the government, 50 per page, filterable by name, chamber, parliamentary group and département code, with counts per chamber and the latest public votes.

tools.name: find_representatives
tools.description: Deputies and senators of a commune given by name or INSEE code. An ambiguous name returns candidate communes. A commune split between several constituencies has several deputies: pass the address longitude and latitude (WGS84) to get the single deputy of that address, as the site's address finder do

tools.name: get_elected_person
tools.description: One deputy, senator or member of the government by id (e.g. PA841605, from search or list_elected): mandates, voting participation, latest votes and summary of HATVP declarations of interests.

tools.name: list_local_executives
tools.description: National register of elected officials (RNE): counts of mandate rows by kind, sex, age band and département, optionally for one département, and mayors searchable by name or commune, 50 per page.

tools.name: get_local_executive
tools.description: One mayor from the national register of elected officials, by id (from list_local_executives).

tools.name: list_votes
tools.description: Public votes of the Assemblée nationale and the Sénat, newest first, 50 per page, filterable by chamber and by title words or vote number.

tools.name: get_vote
tools.description: One public vote by id (e.g. VTANR5L17V9469 or SEN2026-46, from list_votes): result, counts by group and position, and vote corrections. Pass `group` (a group_label from groups) for each of its members' positions.

tools.name: get_official_journal
tools.description: Latest editions of the Journal officiel: published texts, 40 per page, filterable by date, nature, ministry and appointment class, with counts by nature, ministry and day and the number of appointments.

tools.name: list_legislative_files
tools.description: Legislative files from DILA (DOLE), the Assemblée nationale and the Sénat, 40 per page, filterable by title words, source, status, legislature and finance laws.

tools.name: get_legislative_file
tools.description: One legislative file by id (e.g. an-DLR5L17N53329, from list_legislative_files): steps (50 per page), documents and the same law's files at other publishers.

tools.name: list_administrations
tools.description: Directory of State administrations (ROAE and DILA directory), 40 per page, filterable by name, by category, or to bodies headed by a member of the government.

tools.name: get_administration
tools.description: One administration by id (a UUID, from list_administrations or search): parent bodies, then child bodies and communes covered, 50 per page each.

tools.name: get_public_expenses
tools.description: Means of public office: reference allowances of parliamentarians, members of the government and local officials, ministerial cabinet staff, CADA opinions on access to documents, and the Pouvoirs publics budget.

tools.name: get_glossary
tools.description: Definitions of the terms the site uses (marché public, strate, médiane, épargne brute...), grouped by theme.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Every source the site uses with its id, name, publisher, data date and freshness, plus the social protection total quoted on the methodology page. `source` filters by source name, publisher or id and gives each match in full: licence, coverage, rows, SHA-256, known limits, the first URL fetched and

tools.name: list_downloads
tools.description: Derived data tables published under Licence Ouverte 2.0, with formats and sizes. Each file is at https://chaqueeuro.fr/telechargements/fichiers/<file>. `table` gives one table with the SHA-256 of its files.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
